# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [Unreleased]

### Fixed
- **Options Sub-Tab Wrapping (`UI/OptionsFrame.lua`)**: Wrapped plugin sub-tabs into multiple rows inside `CraftForgeOptionsWindow` and stripped color codes when measuring tab widths so many installed plugins no longer overflow past the right window edge.
- **Threshold Bar Formatting (`Core/CraftForgeSkillUp.lua`)**: Added direct `SkillLineAbility` / `SkillLevels` fallback parsing and removed the placeholder `###` bar when no numeric thresholds are present.
- **Developer Scripts (`Scripts/generate-scrollData-retail.py`, `Scripts/SkillLevelsConverter2.py`)**: Replaced leftover `Skillet` namespace references with `CraftForge`, added UTF-8 encoding (`encoding="utf-8"`) and context-managed file handles, fixed a stale `spell_name` variable and missing `ItemEffectID` `KeyError` in `generate-scrollData-retail.py`, and replaced duplicated argument blocks in `SkillLevelsConverter2.py` with a loop.
- **Threshold Lookup in `Core/CraftForgeSkillUp.lua`**: Connected `GetSkillUpThresholds` to `CraftForge:GetTradeSkillLevels(itemID, spellID)` so `SkillLevelData*.lua` thresholds directly power exact skill-up % and threshold bars.
- **LDB / Minimap Left-Click Queue Toggle (`Core/CraftForgeShare.lua`)**: Fixed LDB/Minimap Left-Click calling `ShowQueueView()` (instead of undefined `ShowStandaloneQueue()`) and ensured `CreateTradeSkillWindow()` initializes `CraftForgeStandaloneQueue` if clicked before opening a profession.
- **Altoholic / DataStore Integration in Alt Finder (`UI/AltFinder.lua`)**: Added `DataStore_Crafts` (alt professions & learned recipes) and `DataStore_Mails` (mailbox item counts) alongside `DataStore_Containers` so Altoholic data is searched automatically in `/cf find`.
- **Options Dropdown Arrow (`UI/OptionsFrame.lua`)**: Replaced the literal `"  v"` suffix on dropdown buttons with a proper right-aligned `UI-ChatIcon-ScrollDown-Up` arrow texture.
- **Cooldown Tracker Event Registration (`Core/CraftForgeCooldowns.lua`)**: Replaced unsafe `TRADE_SKILL_UPDATE` registration with `C_EventUtils.IsEventValid`-guarded `TRADE_SKILL_LIST_UPDATE` / `TRADE_SKILL_DETAILS_UPDATE` / `TRADE_SKILL_UPDATE` so WoW Forever and Retail never throw an unknown-event error.
- **WoW Forever Bank Exclusion & Craftable-with-Bank Count (`Core/Inventory.lua`, `Core/CraftForge.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeData.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeQueue.lua`, `UI/MainFrame.lua`)**:
  - Excluded banked reagents from immediate craftability calculations (`numCraftable`, `numRecursive`) and queue reagent checks on WoW Forever (`CraftForge.isForever`), because players cannot remotely craft from bank mats.
  - Added a separate `numCraftableBank` count (shown in light blue in the recipe list brackets and as `"can be created with reagents in your bank"` in the recipe tooltip) whenever bank mats allow crafting more than bags alone.
  - Green recipe count highlighting (`CBAG`) is now strictly reserved for `numCraftable > 0` (immediately craftable from bags), while `0` is shown in grey (`CGREY`).
- **Complete German (`deDE`) Localization (`Locale/Locale-deDE.lua`, `Locale/Locale-enUS.lua`, `UI/FishingFrame.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeNewsGUI.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeShare.lua`, `UI/DetailFrame.lua`, `UI/MainButtons.lua`, `Plugins/Auctionator.lua`, `Plugins/AuctionDB.lua`, `Plugins/OribosExchange.lua`)**: Localized all remaining hardcoded English strings in the Fishing Tracker, Floating Fishing Bar, News window, LDB/Queue Share popups, reagent tooltips, profession button tooltips, and Auctionator/AuctionDB/OribosExchange plugin options.
- **Auto-Process Popup Item Tooltip (`Core/CraftForgeProcess.lua`)**: Added hover tooltip support (`GameTooltip:SetBagItem` / `SetHyperlink`) over the item icon and name in `CraftForgeAutoProcessPrompt`.
- **`/cf` Slash Command Alias (`Core/CraftForgeOptions.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeShare.lua`)**: Registered `"cf"` alongside `"craftforge"` in `AceConfig-3.0:RegisterOptionsTable` and added `"fish"`, `"find"`, and `"process"` to tab completion so `/cf fish`, `/cf find`, `/cf process`, and `/cf` work directly in chat.
- **LDB Data Source & Minimap/Fishing Integration (`Core/CraftForgeShare.lua`)**: Changed the `LibDataBroker-1.1` object from `type = "launcher"` to `type = "data source"` (with `label = "CraftForge"`, `UpdateLDBText()` queue counter, and Middle-Click to open Fishing Tracker) so CraftForge appears in LDB DataText panels (Titan Panel, Bazooka, ChocolateBar, ElvUI DataTexts) as well as `LibDBIcon`.
- **Native Dark-Gold Options Window (`UI/OptionsFrame.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeOptions.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeShare.lua`, `CraftForge.toc`)**: Added a native `CraftForge.UIStyle` Dark-Gold Options window (`CraftForgeOptionsWindow`) rendering all registered `CraftForgeGUI` option groups (`Features`, `Appearance`, `Material Processing`, `Plugins` with sub-tabs, and `Profiles`) without `AceGUI`/`Blizzard_Settings` mixing, and routed `Share:OpenOptions()` (Minimap button) to `CraftForge:ShowOptions()` so the ElvUI/AceGUI window is never opened.
- **Native Dark-Gold News Window (`Core/CraftForgeNewsGUI.lua`)**: Replaced the `AceGUI` / `AceConfigDialog` News window (which ElvUI's built-in Ace3 skinning automatically reskinned) with a native `CraftForge.UIStyle` Dark-Gold frame featuring a gold header bar, version sidebar, scrollable changelog content, and `"Show News"` mode buttons.
- **Material Processing Glow Border (`Core/CraftForgeProcess.lua`)**: Upgraded the `process_glow` overlay on `CraftForgeProcessButton` to a high-visibility animated glowing border (2px additive colored edges, inner additive tint, outer radial glow, pulsing `BOUNCE` animation, and `+20` frame level) so eligible bag items clearly light up when holding the modifier key.

### Changed
- **In-Game Plugin Descriptions (`Core/CraftForgePlugin.lua`, `Locale/Locale-enUS.lua`, `Locale/Locale-deDE.lua`)**: Added localized (`enUS` / `deDE`) descriptions at the top of every plugin's options panel explaining exactly what data and APIs CraftForge uses from that addon.
- **Detailed Addon Integration Documentation (`README.md`)**: Expanded the **Supported Addons & Integrations** table to explicitly document what data/APIs CraftForge uses from every supported addon (including `SkillUp Forever` thresholds).

### Added
- **In-Window Skill-Up Chance & Detail Panel Info (`Core/CraftForgeSkillUp.lua`, `UI/MainFrame.lua`, `UI/DetailFrame.lua`)**: Displayed colored skill-up chance percentages directly in the recipe list rows and added Skill-Up Chance, Thresholds, and Cost / Skill-Up to the recipe detail pane.
- **Skill-Up Chances, Thresholds, Trainer & Reagent Tooltips (`Core/CraftForgeSkillUp.lua`, `UI/MainFrame.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeLeveling.lua`)**: Added skill-up chance percentage, colored threshold bar, and cost-per-skill-up to recipe tooltips and `/cf level`; added trainer service tooltip annotations (`Skill-Up Chance`, `Craft Cost`, `Cost / Skill-Up`) and reagent item tooltips showing Recipe Watch needs plus `Shift`-hover skill-up recipes.
- **Buffs-Only Filter & Crafted Gear Overview (`Core/CraftForgeGear.lua`, `UI/GearFrame.lua`, `UI/MainSideDock.lua`, `UI/Sorting.lua`, `Core/RecipeGroups.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeOptions.lua`)**: Added a one-click **Buffs only** filter toggle in the side dock (consumables & enhancements usable at player level) and a Dark-Gold **Crafted Gear** (`/cf gear`) slot-based browser sorted by item level.
- **Questie & AtlasLootClassic Plugins (`Plugins/Questie.lua`, `Plugins/AtlasLoot.lua`, `CraftForge.toc`)**: Added optional integrations displaying vendor NPCs/zones, drops, and quest sources when Questie or AtlasLootClassic is loaded.
- **AchievementsUtils Plugin (`Plugins/AchievementsUtils.lua`, `CraftForge.toc`)**: Added optional integration with [AchievementsUtils](https://github.com/d4kir92/AchievementsUtils) (via `FindByCriteriaName`, `GetAchievement`, and `GetAchievementCriteriaInfo`) to display achievement prefix icons and uncompleted achievement criteria details on matching recipes and crafted items.
- **Main Window All-in-One Side Dock (`UI/MainSideDock.lua`, `UI/MainFrame.lua`, `CraftForge.toc`)**: Added a collapsible Dark-Gold side dock (`CraftForgeSideToolsDock`) attached to the main profession window with one-click buttons for Leveling Planner, Crafting Cooldowns (with ready count badge), Recipe Watch HUD, Gathering Guide, Trade Contacts, Fishing, Camping, Alt Finder, and Material Processing.
- **Interactive Key & Mouse Keybind Capture (`UI/OptionsFrame.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeOptions.lua`)**: Added native `type = "keybinding"` capture support in `CraftForgeOptionsWindow` so Fishing Cast/Lure and Pole/Weapon Swap bindings automatically detect keyboard keys, modifiers (`ALT`/`CTRL`/`SHIFT`), extra mouse buttons (`BUTTON3`/`BUTTON4`/`BUTTON5`), and mouse wheel (`MOUSEWHEELUP`/`MOUSEWHEELDOWN`) on click.
- **All-in-One Profession Suite (`Core/CraftForgeLeveling.lua`, `UI/LevelingFrame.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeCooldowns.lua`, `UI/CooldownsFrame.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeWatch.lua`, `UI/WatchFrame.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeGathering.lua`, `UI/GatheringFrame.lua`, `UI/ContactsFrame.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeCamping.lua`, `UI/CampingFrame.lua`)**:
  - **Smart Leveling Planner (`/cf level`)**: Calculates cost-aware skill-up paths from current to target skill, generates an aggregated material shopping list, and queues steps in one click.
  - **Account-Wide Cooldown Tracker (`/cf cd`)**: Tracks crafting cooldowns across all characters with login notifications, LDB tooltip integration, and a Dark-Gold countdown window.
  - **Recipe Watch HUD (`/cf watch`)**: Movable on-screen material goal tracker showing live bag progress and ready status for pinned recipes.
  - **Gathering Professions Guide (`/cf gather`)**: Herbalism, Mining, and Skinning skill-up guide with automatic rank detection, difficulty colors, and recommended zones.
  - **Trade Contacts Browser & TomTom Waypoints (`/cf contacts`)**: Searchable Dark-Gold 2-column browser for all visited vendors and trainers showing their sold recipes/goods (with icons, hover tooltips, prices, and limited stock), item/recipe search, and one-click TomTom / map waypoints.
  - **WoW Forever Camping Tracker (`/cf camp`)**: Dedicated Camping skill & milestone progression window.
- **Fishing Tracker, Catch Database, Auto-Lure & Pole Swap (`Core/CraftForgeFishing.lua`, `UI/FishingFrame.lua`, `CraftForge.toc`, `Core/CraftForge.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeOptions.lua`)**:
  - Added `/cf fish` (`CraftForge:ShowFishing()`) Dark-Gold Fishing window displaying current Fishing skill & lure status, session statistics (catches/hr, skill-ups, estimated value), Stranglethorn Derby countdown, zone/subzone catch history, and caught item breakdown (count, drop %, min skill, day/night split, value).
  - Added a movable Dark-Gold **Floating Fishing Bar** (`CraftForgeFishingBar`, toggleable under `Options -> Fishing`) with one-click Cast/Auto-Lure button, Pole/Weapon Swap button (showing the actual swapped weapon or pole icon), live lure countdown, Double-Right-Click Easy-Cast, configurable cast/swap keybinds in Options, full `deDE` localization, and click-to-open catch log.
  - Added secure one-key Fishing cast & automatic best-lure application (`CraftForgeFishingCastButton`) and Fishing Pole / combat weapon swap (`CraftForgeFishingSwapButton`) with WoW Key Bindings integration.
- **Trade Contacts — Visited Vendors & Trainers DB (`Core/CraftForgeContacts.lua`)**:
  - Automatically records visited recipe/tradegood vendors and profession trainers (with zone, coordinates, price, and limited stock) into `CraftForge.db.global.contactsDB` and displays vendor locations on item tooltips.
- **Structured Plugins UI, Active Source Selectors & Addon Versions (`Core/CraftForgePlugin.lua`, `UI/Sorting.lua`, `UI/DetailFrame.lua`, `Plugins/AllTheThings.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeProcess.lua`)**:
  - Filtered plugin detection to only show addons that are actually installed and enabled/loaded (`IsAddOnLoaded` / `GetAddOnEnableState`).
  - Split `Plugins` into clean sections: **Active Sources & Addons** (with installed-only **Auction House Addon** and **Bag Addon** selectors + **Installed Addons & Versions** list) and **Recipe List Display** (Prefix/Suffix selectors), and appended addon version numbers (`GetAddOnMetadata`) to each plugin tab while matching `RecipeNamePrefix`/`RecipeNameSuffix` against base plugin keys.
  - Unified `CraftForge:GetExtraText` and `CraftForgeExtraDetailTextLeft` in `UI/DetailFrame.lua` (full-width inline rows with indented `AllTheThings` source lines) so long plugin labels and wrapped source text never overlap.
  - Wired `preferredAHAddon` into `GetItemMarketOrVendorPrice` and `getMatUnitPrice`.
- **New Addon Integrations (`Plugins/TSM.lua`, `Plugins/ElvUI.lua`, `Plugins/BetterBags.lua`, `Plugins/TomTom.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeProcess.lua`, `UI/Sorting.lua`, `UI/AltFinder.lua`, `Core/CraftForgePlugin.lua`, `CraftForge.toc`)**:
  - **TradeSkillMaster (`TSM`)**: Added `GetTSMPrice` (`DBMarket` / `DBMinBuyout` / `DBRegionMarketAvg` / `DBHistorical`) as a market price source in `GetItemMarketOrVendorPrice`, `getMatUnitPrice`, and Recipe Details.
  - **ElvUI (Toggleable Skin)**: Added optional ElvUI skinning (`skinEnabled` toggle in `Plugins -> ElvUI`, disabled by default so CraftForge keeps its native Dark-Gold UI unless enabled) and applied `UIStyle.SkinFrame` to `CraftForgeNewsGUI` so the News window matches CraftForge's Dark-Gold theme.
  - **Bag Addon Compatibility (`BetterBags`, `Bagnon`, `Combuctor`, `ArkInventory`, `ElvUI Bags`, `AdiBags`, `LiteBag`)**: Added `BetterBags` queue-reagent category registration and expanded `extractBagSlotFromOwner` in `CraftForgeProcess` for all major bag addons.
  - **TomTom, Pawn & DataStore**: Added `TomTom` waypoint helper, `Pawn` gear-upgrade protection in the Auto-Process Popup, and `DataStore` inventory fallback in `/cf find`.
- **Crafting Cost & Profit Calculator (`UI/Sorting.lua`, `UI/MainFrame.lua`)**: Added `GetItemMarketOrVendorPrice` and `GetRecipeCostAndProfit`, a `By Profit` sorter, `Craft Cost` / `Sell Value` / `Profit` display in recipe hover tooltips, and `Only Profitable` + `Has Source Info` filter checkboxes in `UI/Filtering.lua`.
- **Alt Recipe & Inventory Finder (`UI/AltFinder.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeOptions.lua`, `CraftForge.toc`)**: Added `CraftForge:ShowAltFinder()` (`/cf find`) to search known recipes and stored reagents across all characters on the realm.
- **Material Processing Batch Panel & Optional Auto-Process Popup (`Core/CraftForgeProcess.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeOptions.lua`, `Core/CraftForge.lua`)**: Added `CraftForge:ShowProcessPanel()` (`/cf process` and Settings button) listing all disenchantable, prospectable, millable, and locked bag items with secure one-click macro buttons, plus an optional Auto-Process Popup (`process_autopopup`) for newly looted/acquired eligible items with Process, Session Skip, Permanent Ignore, and item vs. expected yield value comparison.
- **Recipe Source in Hover Tooltip & AllTheThings Source Fallback (`UI/MainFrame.lua`, `Plugins/AckisRecipeList.lua`, `Plugins/AllTheThings.lua`)**: Added `C_TradeSkillUI.GetRecipeSourceText` display with an `AllTheThings` parent-path source fallback (`GetRecipeSource`) in `SkillButton_OnEnter` recipe tooltips (with `Source:` as a dedicated header and each source on its own unwrapped line) and `GetExtraText` details.
- **AllTheThings Plugin (`Plugins/AllTheThings.lua`, `Core/CraftForgePlugin.lua`, `CraftForge.toc`)**: Added `AllTheThings` integration displaying item and recipe collection status via `RecipeNamePrefix` and in Recipe Details (`GetExtraText`), with per-status toggles (`Show item collection status`, `Show recipe collection status`) in `Plugins -> AllTheThings`.
- **Baganator & Syndicator Compatibility (`Plugins/Baganator.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeProcess.lua`, `CraftForge.toc`)**:
  - Added `owner.BGR.itemLocation` support (and cached/offline button guard) in `CraftForgeProcess` so one-click Disenchanting/Prospecting/Milling/Pick Lock works directly on Baganator item slots.
  - Added `Plugins/Baganator.lua` with a `Baganator.API.RegisterCornerWidget` queue-reagent highlight in Baganator bags and `Syndicator.API.GetInventoryInfoByItemID` total item count display in Recipe Details.
- **Ace3 Enhancements (`Core/CraftForgeShare.lua`, `Core/CraftForge.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeOptions.lua`, `CraftForge.toc`, `.pkgmeta`)**:
  - **Event Throttling (`AceBucket-3.0`)**: Throttled high-frequency `BAG_UPDATE` events (`0.25s` bucket) in `Core/CraftForge.lua`.
  - **Queue Export/Import & Guild/Party Sync (`AceSerializer-3.0`, `LibDeflate`, `AceGUI-3.0`, `AceComm-3.0`)**: Added `CraftForge:NewModule("Share")` with `/craftforge export`, `/craftforge import`, and `/craftforge sendqueue` (with `StaticPopupDialogs` confirmation).
  - **Minimap & DataBroker Launcher (`LibDataBroker-1.1`, `LibDBIcon-1.0`)** + **Standalone Options (`AceConfigDialog-3.0`)**: Added minimap toggle (`/craftforge minimap`) and `/craftforge options`.
  - **Chat Autocomplete (`AceTab-3.0`)**: Added `<Tab>` completion for `/craftforge ` and `/cf ` subcommands and saved queue names.
- **Modern Dark-Gold UI Style (`UI/UIStyle.lua`, `CraftForge.toc`)**: Added `CraftForge.UIStyle` matching the shared Dark-Gold theme (`ApplyBox`, `SkinFrame`, `SkinInset`, `StyleHeaderBar`, `SkinButton`, `SkinCloseButton`, `SkinEditBox`, `StyleScrollBar`, `CreateHeader`, `CreateButton`, `CreateFilterPill`, `CreateCheckBox`, `CreateEditBox`, `uiFontSize` scaling).
- **Material Yield Tooltips & Dedicated Settings (`Core/CraftForgeProcess.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeOptions.lua`, `Core/CraftForge.lua`)**:
  - Added item tooltip yield breakdown (Disenchanting, Prospecting, Milling) with drop percentages, stack ranges, and expected gold value (`Auctionator` / vendor prices) using built-in yield tables.
  - Registered `Material Processing` as a dedicated top-level tab/category in both Blizzard Settings and `CraftForgeGUI` with toggles for Disenchant/Prospect/Mill yield tooltips and expected value calculation.
- **One-Click Material Processing (`Core/CraftForgeProcess.lua`, `Core/CraftForge.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeOptions.lua`, `Locale/Locale-enUS.lua`, `Locale/Locale-deDE.lua`, `CraftForge.toc`)**: Integrated one-click **Disenchanting**, **Prospecting**, **Milling**, and **Pick Lock** via a combat-safe `SecureActionButtonTemplate` overlay (`CraftForgeProcessButton`), supporting both Retail (`TooltipDataProcessor`) and Classic (`OnTooltipSetItem`) with full AceConfig options (modifier key, per-action toggles, max disenchant quality, glow highlight).
- **CraftForge Rebranding & Brand Assets (`CraftForge.toc`, `.github/assets/logo.jpg`, `.github/assets/social-banner.jpg`, `README.md`)**: Rebranded the entire addon from `Skillet` to `CraftForge` (identifiers, SavedVariables, frames, locales, slash commands, `.toc`, `.pkgmeta`, `.luacheckrc`), added custom CraftForge logo and social preview banner, and updated `README.md` with standard badges and documentation.
- **Code Quality & Packaging Infrastructure (`.luacheckrc`, `.gitignore`, `.gitattributes`, `.github/workflows/quality.yml`)**: Added `luacheck` configuration, `Code Quality` GitHub Actions workflow (`luacheck` + `.toc` validation), and export/packaging ignores for dev scripts (`*.js`, `*.py`).

### Changed
- **UI Spacing, Typography, Group Headers, Level Column & Dropdown Skinning (`UI/UIStyle.lua`, `UI/MainFrame.xml`, `UI/MainFrame.lua`)**: Reorganized the top-left filter/sort/search controls into a compact 2x2 toolbar aligned with the right pane (`y = -114`), increased recipe row height (`20px`) with distinct warm dark-gold group header bars (`cfHeaderTop`/`cfHeaderBottom` borders, `3px` left accent bar, brighter header font) clearly separated from child rows, right-aligned the compact recipe level column (`justifyH="RIGHT"` without inflating category headers), upgraded `$parentLevel`, `$parentCounts`, and `$parentSuffix` from `GameFontNormalSmall` to `GameFontNormal` with `UIStyle.ApplyFont` scaling so numbers match recipe text size, added clean spacing between `CraftForgeAdd10Button` and `CraftForgeQueueButton`/`CraftForgeCreateButton`, added `UIStyle.SkinDropDown`, skinned `CraftForgeRankFrame` with `UIStyle.SkinInset` matching `reagent_width`, widened tab buttons, applied `uiFontSize` scaling, and centered `CraftForgeItemCountInputBox`.
- **Code Quality & Warning Cleanup (`Core/CraftForgeData.lua`, `Core/Inventory.lua`, `Core/RecipeGroups.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeOptions.lua`, `UI/MainButtons.lua`)**: Replaced `string.split` with `strsplit` across `Core/`, `UI/`, and `Plugins/`, and renamed the duplicate `header` key in `CraftForgeOptions.lua` to `shoppingHeader` so the top Features header is no longer overwritten.
- **Installed-Only Plugin Options & Localization (`Core/CraftForgePlugin.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeOptions.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeShare.lua`, `Plugins/Baganator.lua`, `Locale/Locale-enUS.lua`, `Locale/Locale-deDE.lua`)**: Filtered plugin options and Prefix/Suffix dropdowns to only show installed addons (`IsPluginAddonInstalled`), hid empty Prefix/Suffix selectors, added clear explanatory text (`PluginRecipeNameHelp`) and descriptive Prefix/Suffix labels, labeled `" "` as `L["None"]`, and localized remaining English strings into German (`deDE`) and English (`enUS`).
- **CraftForge News & Version (`Core/CraftForgeNewsData.lua`, `CraftForge.toc`)**: Replaced legacy Skillet `5.xx` news entries with CraftForge `1.0.0` highlights and set `## Version: 1.0.0` in `CraftForge.toc` (unreleased).

### Removed
- **Unused Settings Cleanup (`Core/CraftForgeOptions.lua`, `Core/CraftForge.lua`)**: Removed dead/unreferenced options (`display_full_tooltip`, `display_item_tooltip`, `queue_to_front`, `altskilllevels`, `baseskilllevel`) after auditing all profile settings against runtime usage.
- **Legacy `CraftForgeTradeskillTooltip` (`UI/MainFrame.xml`)**: Removed the unused commented-out `CraftForgeTradeskillTooltip` definition from `UI/MainFrame.xml`.

### Fixed
- **ALT-Modifier One-Click Disenchanting & `ActionButtonUseKeyDown` Fix (`Core/CraftForgeProcess.lua`)**: Fixed `isSpellKnownSafe` to check all spell-known APIs (`IsSpellKnown`, `IsPlayerSpell`, `C_SpellBook.IsSpellInSpellBook`, `IsSpellKnownOrOverridesKnown`), switched `CraftForgeProcessButton` from `type="spell"` to `type="macro"` (`/cast ...\n/use bag slot`) across `alt-`/`ctrl-`/`shift-` modifier attributes so Blizzard's self-cast modifier cannot swallow ALT-clicks, respected `ActionButtonUseKeyDown` (`LeftButtonDown` vs. `LeftButtonUp`) on both `CraftForgeProcessButton` and `CraftForgeAutoProcessActionBtn`, and moved `MODIFIER_STATE_CHANGED`/`PLAYER_REGEN_DISABLED` onto `processEventFrame`.
- **Fixed-Size Main Frame & Rank Bar Spacing (`UI/MainFrame.xml`, `UI/MainFrame.lua`)**: Locked `CraftForgeFrame` to a fixed `900x620` non-resizable layout (`resizable="false"`), set `CRAFTFORGE_REAGENT_MAX_WIDTH = 385`, and tightened `CraftForgeSortDropdown` spacing (`x="54"`) so the 2x2 left toolbar, recipe list, profession icons, and `Ignore List` / `Queues` / `Notes` buttons have clean breathing room without overlap.
- **Merchant Exact-Funds Edge Case (`UI/MerchantWindow.lua`)**: Fixed `money >= cost` check in `BuyRequiredReagents` and added item name fallback in `MerchantBuyButton_OnEnter`.
- **Uniform Dropdown Checkboxes (`UI/Filtering.lua`, `UI/Sorting.lua`, `UI/QueueMgt.lua`, `Core/RecipeGroups.lua`, `UI/RecipeRank.lua`)**: Set `isNotRadio = true` (and `notCheckable = true` for action menus) with explicit `checked` states across all CraftForge dropdowns so radio circles and square checkboxes are never mixed.
- **Auto-Process Popup Event & Default Fix (`Core/CraftForgeProcess.lua`, `Core/CraftForge.lua`)**: Moved `BAG_UPDATE_DELAYED` / `BAG_UPDATE` / `PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD` / `PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED` tracking to a dedicated `processEventFrame` so it no longer collides with `CraftForge:BAG_UPDATE_DELAYED()`, enabled `process_autopopup = true` by default (optional via Settings/Ignore), and scheduled an initial bag check after login/reload.
- **Recipe Source Setting (`show_recipe_source_for_learned`) Respected Everywhere (`Plugins/AllTheThings.lua`, `UI/MainFrame.lua`)**: Updated both `AllTheThings:GetExtraText` and `SkillButton_OnEnter` hover tooltips to hide recipe acquisition sources for already-learned recipes when `show_recipe_source_for_learned` is disabled, matching `UI/DetailFrame.lua`.
- **Recipe Hover Tooltip Styling, Scale Restore & Stuck Tooltip Fix (`UI/MainFrame.lua`, `UI/MainFrame.xml`)**: Added `GameTooltip:Hide()` and `GameTooltip:SetScale(CraftForge.gttScale)` restoration to `CraftForgeSkillButtonTemplate` (`OnLeave`/`OnHide`) and `CraftForgeFrame` (`OnHide`), gated recipe tooltip scaling behind `scale_tooltip` so `GameTooltip` scale is never altered globally, anchored `SkillButton_OnEnter` to `ANCHOR_RIGHT` with dark-gold styling, and replaced newline-prefixed `AddLine` calls with clean `AddDoubleLine` rows so counts like `im Inventar` never wrap across two lines.
- **Profession Button Ranks, Bank Crafting, Enchant Target, Skillup Sync & Item Preload (`Core/CraftForgeData.lua`, `Core/Inventory.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeQueue.lua`, `Core/CraftForge.lua`)**:
  - Updated `ScanPlayerTradeSkills` to preserve existing rank/maxRank/link data and populate live profession ranks from `GetProfessions`/`GetProfessionInfo` and `GetNumSkillLines`/`GetSkillLineInfo` so non-active profession button tooltips no longer show `[0/0]`.
  - Removed the `isForever` bank-reagent exclusion in `InventorySkillIterations` and `CraftForgeQueue` so crafting from bank works when `ignore_banked_reagents` is disabled.
  - Enabled `C_TradeSkillUI.CraftEnchant` target support (`enchantTargetLocation` / `GetAutoTargetItem`) across flavors when available.
  - Added a debounced fallback rescan on `SKILL_LINES_CHANGED` (preventing recipe list desync after skillups) and a debounced `UpdateTradeSkillWindow` refresh on `GET_ITEM_INFO_RECEIVED` (so uncached item names/icons populate automatically on login).
- **Combat Lockdown `EnableKeyboard()` Protection (`UI/MainFrame.xml`)**: Guarded all `EnableKeyboard()` calls in `CraftForgeFrame`, `CraftForgeSkillButtonTemplate`, and `CraftForgeEmptySpaceTemplate` with `if not InCombatLockdown() then ... end` to prevent `ADDON_ACTION_BLOCKED` errors when hiding or interacting with the frame during combat.
- **Shopping List Button Anchoring (`UI/ShoppingList.lua`)**: Guarded `get_button` and `UpdateShoppingListWindow` against `button_count <= 0` so `CraftForgeShoppingListButton0` never attempts to anchor to `CraftForgeShoppingListButton-1`.
- **Sorting Dropdown Blank Default (`UI/Sorting.lua`)**: Fixed `SortDropdown_Initialize` so a saved `"None"` sort option matches localized `sorters[1]` (e.g. `"Keine"` in `deDE`) instead of leaving `CraftForgeSortDropdown` blank.
- **Dark-Gold UI Redesign (`UI/MainFrame.lua`, `UI/ShoppingList.lua`, `UI/IgnoreList.lua`, `UI/OptionalList.lua`, `UI/RequiredList.lua`, `UI/FinishingList.lua`, `UI/ModifiedList.lua`, `UI/SalvageList.lua`, `UI/RecipeNotes.lua`)**: Replaced legacy Ace2 Waterfall green titlebars and standard Blizzard backdrops/buttons/editboxes/scrollbars across the main trade skill window, standalone queue, shopping list, and reagent/ignore/notes panels with the unified Modern Dark-Gold UI Style (preserving `tsm_compat` mode).
- **Multi-Flavor TOC & Project Flags (`CraftForge.toc`, `Core/CraftForge.lua`)**: Added full multi-flavor `## Interface` and per-flavor `## Interface-*` headers (`Retail`, `Classic`, `Forever`, `BCC`, `Wrath`, `Titan`, `Cata`, `Mists`), extended `Data\SkillLevelData1.lua` `AllowLoadGameType` to all non-standard flavors, and populated `isClassic`/`isBCC`/`isWrath`/`isCata`/`isMists` project flags in `Core/CraftForge.lua`.
- **Directory Structure & External Libraries (`Core/`, `Data/`, `Utils/`, `Scripts/`, `Skillet.toc`, `.pkgmeta`, `UI/DetailFrame.lua`)**:
  - Reorganized root Lua files into `Core/`, `Data/`, and `Utils/`, and moved developer scripts into `Scripts/` (excluded from packaging via `.pkgmeta` and `.gitattributes`).
  - Removed embedded `Libs/EasySkillet/` and replaced `EasySkillet(...)` in `UI/DetailFrame.lua` with `MenuUtil.CreateContextMenu` (with `EasyMenu` fallback).
  - Updated `.pkgmeta` externals for `LibStub`, `CallbackHandler-1.0`, and all `Ace3` libraries to pull directly from `https://github.com/WoWUIDev/Ace3`.
- **Release Workflow & Packaging (`.github/workflows/release.yml`, `.pkgmeta`, `Skillet.toc`)**: Updated GitHub Actions to `actions/checkout@v4` and `BigWigsMods/packager@v2` with `.github/CHANGELOG.md` support, excluded dev scripts in `.pkgmeta`, and fixed `## X-License: GPL-3.0` syntax in `Skillet.toc`.

- **Complete `enUS` & `deDE` Localization + All Locales Synchronized (`Locale/Locale-*.lua`)**: Populated all 319 CraftForge `L[...]` keys across `enUS` and `deDE` (including XML tooltips in `UI/MainFrame.xml`) and synchronized all remaining locale files (`esES`, `frFR`, `itIT`, `koKR`, `ptBR`, `ruRU`, `zhCN`, `zhTW`) with `enUS` fallbacks.
- **Default UI & Standalone Options (`Core/CraftForgeOptions.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeShare.lua`, `UI/MainFrame.lua`)**: Added `Minimap Button` to Appearance and `Export Queue` / `Import Queue` to Features (visible in both Blizzard Default UI Settings and `CraftForgeGUI`), added Classic/Forever `InterfaceOptionsFrame_OpenToCategory` fallback in `ShowOptions()`, and bound the header gear button to open Blizzard Default UI Settings (Shift-click for standalone `CraftForgeGUI`).
- **Options Header Button & Transmog Known/Unknown Indicator (`UI/MainFrame.lua`)**: Skinned `CraftForgeShowOptionsButton` with a gear icon + tooltip next to the close button (replacing the broken Retail microbutton texture) and added a ✓ / ✗ transmog appearance indicator for gear/cosmetic recipes (`CanIMogIt` or `C_TransmogCollection`).
- **Complete `enUS` & `deDE` Localization + All Locales Synchronized (`Locale/Locale-*.lua`)**: Populated all 319 CraftForge `L[...]` keys across `enUS` and `deDE` (including XML tooltips in `UI/MainFrame.xml`) and synchronized all remaining locale files (`esES`, `frFR`, `itIT`, `koKR`, `ptBR`, `ruRU`, `zhCN`, `zhTW`) with `enUS` fallbacks.
- **Default UI & Standalone Options (`Core/CraftForgeOptions.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeShare.lua`, `UI/MainFrame.lua`)**: Added `Minimap Button` to Appearance and `Export Queue` / `Import Queue` to Features (visible in both Blizzard Default UI Settings and `CraftForgeGUI`), added Classic/Forever `InterfaceOptionsFrame_OpenToCategory` fallback in `ShowOptions()`, and bound the header gear button to open Blizzard Default UI Settings (Shift-click for standalone `CraftForgeGUI`).
- **Options Header Button & Transmog Known/Unknown Indicator (`UI/MainFrame.lua`)**: Skinned `CraftForgeShowOptionsButton` with a gear icon + tooltip next to the close button (replacing the broken Retail microbutton texture) and added a ✓ / ✗ transmog appearance indicator for gear/cosmetic recipes (`CanIMogIt` or `C_TransmogCollection`).
- **Missing Default Anchor on Fresh Install (`UI/MainFrame.xml`, `UI/MainFrame.lua`)**: Added `<Anchor point="CENTER"/>` to `CraftForgeFrame` and a `frame:GetNumPoints() == 0` fallback after `LibWindow-1.1` `RestorePosition` for `CraftForgeFrame` and `CraftForgeStandaloneQueue` so the window is always visible on first launch.
- **Retail 12.x `AutoCastShineTemplate` Error & `AceBucket-3.0` `BAG_UPDATE` (`Core/CraftForgeProcess.lua`, `Core/CraftForge.lua`)**:
  - Removed missing `AutoCastShineTemplate` inheritance on `CraftForgeProcessButton` and replaced `AutoCastShine_AutoCastStart`/`Stop` with a universal `UI-ActionButton-Border` (`ADD` blend) glow texture compatible with Retail 12.x and Classic/Forever.
  - Unpacked `AceBucket-3.0`'s `{ [bagID] = count }` table in `CraftForge:OnBagUpdateBucket` before forwarding numeric `bagID`s to `CraftForge:BAG_UPDATE`.
- **Retail 12.x `AutoCastShineTemplate` Error & `AceBucket-3.0` `BAG_UPDATE` (`Core/CraftForgeProcess.lua`, `Core/CraftForge.lua`)**:
  - Removed missing `AutoCastShineTemplate` inheritance on `CraftForgeProcessButton` and replaced `AutoCastShine_AutoCastStart`/`Stop` with a universal `UI-ActionButton-Border` (`ADD` blend) glow texture compatible with Retail 12.x and Classic/Forever.
  - Unpacked `AceBucket-3.0`'s `{ [bagID] = count }` table in `CraftForge:OnBagUpdateBucket` before forwarding numeric `bagID`s to `CraftForge:BAG_UPDATE`.
- **Duplicate Title FontString Names (`UI/IgnoreList.lua`, `UI/ModifiedList.lua`)**: Fixed `CraftForgeShoppingListTitleText` copy-paste global name collisions by using `CraftForgeIgnoreListTitleText` and `CraftForgeModifiedListTitleText`.
- **Blizzard Frame Compatibility & Duplicate Hook Guards (`Core/CraftForge.lua`, `Core/CraftForgeOptions.lua`, `UI/MainButtons.lua`, `UI/MainFrame.lua`)**:
  - Added nil-safe `ProfessionsFrame or TradeSkillFrame` guards in `EnableBlizzardFrame`, `SetSelectedSkill`, `CraftForgeOptions` (`btsui`), and `UI/MainButtons.lua` to prevent crashes on clients without `ProfessionsFrame`.
  - Prevented duplicate `HookScript("OnClick", ...)` registrations on `CloseButton` in `UI/MainButtons.lua`.
  - Removed unused `color`/`skillIndex` declarations in `UI/MainFrame.lua`.
- **Auctionator, AuctionDB, OribosExchange & BeanCounter Plugin Fixes (`Plugins/Auctionator.lua`, `UI/DetailFrame.lua`, `Plugins/AuctionDB.lua`, `Plugins/OribosExchange.lua`, `Plugins/BeanCounter.lua`)**:
  - Enabled the Auctionator search button in `UI/DetailFrame.lua` on Classic clients (`AuctionFrame` in addition to `AuctionHouseFrame`), added API/empty-list/scrollName guards in `AuctionatorSearch`, fixed duplicate `order` key in options, and guarded Journalator `failedCount` with `or 0`.
  - Fixed `Plugins/OribosExchange.lua` `RecipeNameSuffix` returning `nil` due to out-of-scope `local value` and fixed Classic reagent ID lookup (`v.id` vs `v.reagentID`).
  - Fixed `Plugins/AuctionDB.lua` multiplying reagent cost by `recipe.numMade` instead of `needed`, guarded `nil` `itemID` in `AHDB_Price`, and guarded `nil` `reagentName` in `string.format`.
  - Fixed `Plugins/BeanCounter.lua` `SortSoldAmount` comparing `a.recipeData.itemID` against itself instead of `b.recipeData.itemID`.
- **Plugin Integration Fixes (`Core/CraftForgePlugin.lua`, `Plugins/AckisRecipeList.lua`, `CraftForge.toc`)**:
  - Fixed `CraftForge:IsRecipeNamePluginRegistered` referencing non-existent `CraftForge.RecipeNamePlugins` instead of `RecipeNamePrefixes` / `RecipeNameSuffixes`.
  - Initialized `local ARLProfessionInitialized = {}` in `Plugins/AckisRecipeList.lua` to prevent nil indexing and global leaks.
  - Added missing plugin addons (`AckisRecipeList`, `AuctionDB`, `CanIMogIt`, `DataStore_Auctions`, `Overachiever`) to `## OptionalDeps:` in `CraftForge.toc` and removed obsolete `Plugins/TheUndermineJournal.lua`.
- **BeanCounter Gold Sorting (`Plugins/BeanCounter.lua`)**: Removed `or 0` on multi-return `plugin.GetBCValues(...)` call in `SortGoldEarned` which discarded the 5th return value (`itemValueA`/`itemValueB`) and caused it to always evaluate to `0`.
- **Undefined `tradeskill` & Global Leak in `UI/Sorting.lua`**: Passed `tradeskill` properly into `get_suffix(tradeskill, recipe, first)` and localized `actualRecipe`.
- **Debug Stack Bug in `DeepCopy.lua`**: Added missing `stack` parameter to `DA.deepcopy_push(stack, ...)` and fixed `stack_top` typo to `stack._top`.
- **Global Variable Leaks & Redundant Assignments**: Localized leaked globals (`action`, `name`, `mitem`, `toolName`, `oreagentID`, `ocurrencyID`, `freagentID`, `mreagentID`, `sreagentID`, `_`) across `Skillet.lua`, `SkillLevelData.lua`, `SkilletQueue.lua`, `UI/DetailFrame.lua`, `UI/OptionalList.lua`, `UI/RequiredList.lua`, `UI/FinishingList.lua`, `UI/ModifiedList.lua`, `UI/SalvageList.lua`, and `UI/MainButtons.lua`; removed redundant `= 0` / `numowned` initializations in `Inventory.lua` and `UI/MainFrame.lua`.
